heading: Control flow
body: Loops, conditionals and switches are elements. So you can see the structure in the markup. A conditional is always `<logic>`: `<logic :if>`, then `<logic :else-if>`, then `<logic else>`. A loop is always `<loop :for>`. There is no `<if>`, `<else>` or `<for>` element: the build stops with `TY1367`, and `ty migrate fix --write` rewrites them. A loop's binding (the name of the current item) exists only inside the loop. In <loop :for="topic of documentation.topics()">, the binding topic has the name of a service. Inside the loop, topic reads the item. It does not load TopicService.
